title: Airavatesvara Temple

buildingCutout.basis: Replace the named temple precinct building relation using its mapped outer cloister. The court remains open within the authored structure.

terrainReference.basis: Original sampled elevation at the eastern courtyard approach outside the principal temple.

mapIdentity.provider: Named OpenStreetMap multipolygon with the enclosing gallery, actual open court, main temple and north shrine traced separately.
mapIdentity.scope: The named OSM multipolygon gives the outer cloister, open court, 12-point main temple and adjacent northern shrine, corroborated by OSM node Q3437182 and the official monument descriptions.

note: UNESCO records the 24 m vimana and the front stone chariot hall, while the Archaeological Survey of India and Government Museum document five stone storeys, the axial hall arrangement and extensive carved pillars and cornices.
